paper_id: Hierarchical RNN with Static Sentence-Level Attention for Text-Based Speaker Change Detection
title: Hierarchical RNN with Static Sentence-Level Attention for Text-Based Speaker Change Detection
motivation: Text-based SCD lacks specialized research; needed for OpenSubtitle without speaker IDs and dialog analysis requiring semantics beyond audio
problem_framing: Binary sentence-pair classification: judge speaker change between consecutive sentence pairs using surrounding context
key_insight: Static attention—only critical sentences search for relevant info—avoids burying them, unlike dynamic cross-RNN attention
method_signature: Hierarchical LSTM-RNN with static sentence-level attention for utterance matching before/after decision points
evaluation_criteria: Accuracy and F1-measure (imbalanced 25% speaker changes; F1 critical)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Dynamic attention hurts 1-2% F1; 'may bury the critical sentences' under context propagation
thinking_moves: Reformulate task as matching problem vs traditional segmentation
Static attention design: fix critical sentences as search queries
Reverse LSTM direction from far to near sentences
